title: Rasigan
desc: Vijay and Anitha fall head over heels in love with each other, but are are unable to express their feelings. When Anitha's father gets a wind of it, he tries separating the couple.

title: Paadum Paravaigal
desc: James, a forest ranger, investigates a series of murders committed by a man-eating tiger. Upon further investigation, he finds the truth behind those heinous crimes.

title: Album
desc: Jeevan's father helps Annachi after she is cheated by his brother. He soon becomes the object of affection of Annachi's daughter, but he turns her down to pursue other goals in life.

title: Aranmanai Kavalan
desc: Sakthi takes upon himself to protect and fight for every Tamilian thriving in Mumbai. When he meets the wife of the late community-chief, he makes up his mind to resolve her family issues.
